items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And Bird and everybody used to hang out in his room. He had a room right on the first floor of the hotel. We used to sit in there and get (inaudible) and make little home recordings and things.

ctx.x: All right. Yes, we went back, and of course we were back in school. We worked around, and actually, at that time we had on piano a great little man by the name of Charlie Durham. Charlie Durham was a great fullback on the highschool team. And he played beautiful piano. He had been working with us, and he was a little short guy, could do ten seconds flat, a hundred yards, in his football togs. He was a great little fullback.

And so Charlie had to leave the band, and we were auditioning piano players. So I just want to make one correction in John Chilton's Who's Who of Jazz, and where he mentioned that when I changed to tenor sax and played with local Blue Moon Chasers, and occasionally in a big band organized by
